column1: campus|n.|校园|on campus|There is a small lake on campus.|校园里有一个小湖。|The campus is quiet during the holidays.|假期里校园很安静。
semester|n.|学期|this semester|I am taking four courses this semester.|我这学期修四门课。|The new semester begins in September.|新学期九月开始。
course|n.|课程|take a course|She wants to take a course in photography.|她想修一门摄影课。|This course includes weekly discussions.|这门课程每周都有讨论。
lecture|n.|讲座；讲课|attend a lecture|We attended a lecture on Chinese history.|我们听了一场关于中国历史的讲座。|The lecture starts at nine in the main hall.|讲座九点在大厅开始。
professor|n.|教授|a university professor|The professor answered our questions after class.|教授课后回答了我们的问题。|My uncle is a professor of biology.|我叔叔是生物学教授。
student|n.|学生|a college student|Each student has a different way of learning.|每个学生都有不同的学习方式。|A student showed me the way to the library.|一名学生给我指了去图书馆的路。
classmate|n.|同班同学|a former classmate|I met a former classmate on the train.|我在火车上遇到了一位老同学。|My classmate helped me carry the books.|我的同学帮我搬了书。
classroom|n.|教室|in the classroom|Please keep the classroom clean.|请保持教室整洁。|Our classroom is on the second floor.|我们的教室在二楼。
library|n.|图书馆|a public library|The public library closes at eight.|公共图书馆八点关门。|I found this book in the library.|我在图书馆找到了这本书。
textbook|n.|教科书|an English textbook|Bring your English textbook to class.|把你的英语课本带来上课。|The textbook has a useful list of terms.|这本教材有一份实用的术语表。
dictionary|n.|词典|use a dictionary|Use a dictionary to check the spelling.|用词典检查拼写。|This dictionary explains words with simple examples.|这本词典用简单的例子解释单词。
notebook|n.|笔记本|write in a notebook|I write new words in a notebook.|我把新单词写在笔记本里。|She left her notebook on the desk.|她把笔记本落在了书桌上。
chapter|n.|章；篇|the first chapter|Read the first chapter before Friday.|周五之前读完第一章。|Each chapter ends with a short exercise.|每章都以一个简短练习结尾。
assignment|n.|作业；任务|finish an assignment|I need to finish an assignment tonight.|我今晚需要完成一份作业。|The assignment asks us to interview a local artist.|这项作业要求我们采访一位当地艺术家。
essay|n.|短文；论说文|write an essay|We must write an essay about city life.|我们必须写一篇关于城市生活的短文。|Her essay gives three reasons for the change.|她的文章给出了这一变化的三个原因。
examination|n.|考试|a final examination|The final examination lasts two hours.|期末考试持续两小时。|He felt well prepared for the examination.|他觉得自己为考试做好了准备。
grade|n.|成绩等级；分数|a good grade|She received a good grade for her essay.|她的文章获得了好成绩。|Your final grade includes the group project.|你的最终成绩包括小组项目的成绩。
degree|n.|学位|a degree in history|He has a degree in history.|他拥有历史学学位。|She returned to college to complete her degree.|她回到大学完成学位课程。
academic|adj.|学术的；学业的|academic writing|The workshop introduces academic writing.|这个工作坊介绍学术写作。|Students can ask for academic support.|学生可以寻求学业帮助。
attend|v.|参加；出席|attend a meeting|Can you attend the meeting tomorrow?|你明天能参加会议吗？|Only twenty people could attend the workshop.|只有二十人能够参加这个工作坊。
borrow|v.|借入|borrow a book|May I borrow a book from you?|我可以向你借一本书吗？|You can borrow a bicycle at the station.|你可以在车站借一辆自行车。
return|v.|归还|return a book|Please return the book by Monday.|请在周一之前归还这本书。|I will return your umbrella tomorrow.|我明天会把伞还给你。
prepare|v.|准备|prepare for an exam|We need time to prepare for the exam.|我们需要时间备考。|I will prepare dinner before you arrive.|我会在你到来之前准备晚饭。
revise|v.|复习|revise for an exam|She plans to revise for her exams this weekend.|她打算这个周末复习备考。|We revise together in the library after class.|我们课后一起在图书馆复习。
review|v.|回顾；复习|review your notes|Take ten minutes to review your notes.|花十分钟复习你的笔记。|Let us review what we learned yesterday.|让我们回顾一下昨天学过的内容。
understand|v.|理解；明白|understand a question|I do not understand the last question.|我不理解最后一个问题。|The diagram helps us understand how the machine works.|这张图帮助我们理解机器如何工作。
explain|v.|解释；说明|explain a rule|Could you explain the rule again?|你能再解释一次这条规则吗？|The guide will explain how to use the map.|向导会说明如何使用地图。
discuss|v.|讨论|discuss a problem|We should discuss the problem before deciding.|我们应该先讨论问题再做决定。|The class will discuss the story on Friday.|班上周五将讨论这个故事。
knowledge|n.|知识|gain knowledge|Reading helps us gain knowledge.|阅读帮助我们获得知识。|Her knowledge of local history surprised us.|她对当地历史的了解让我们惊讶。
skill|n.|技能；技巧|a useful skill|Cooking is a useful skill.|烹饪是一项实用技能。|This exercise develops your listening skill.|这项练习培养你的听力技能。
ability|n.|能力|the ability to learn|Everyone has the ability to learn new things.|每个人都有学习新事物的能力。|The job requires the ability to work with others.|这份工作需要与他人合作的能力。
effort|n.|努力|make an effort|Please make an effort to arrive on time.|请尽量准时到达。|Her success came after years of effort.|她的成功来自多年的努力。
goal|n.|目标|set a goal|Set a small goal for each week.|每周设定一个小目标。|Our goal is to finish the project by June.|我们的目标是在六月之前完成项目。
plan|n.|计划|make a plan|We made a plan for the summer holiday.|我们制定了暑假计划。|The plan leaves enough time for rest.|这份计划留出了足够的休息时间。
practice|n.|练习|regular practice|Regular practice makes the task easier.|经常练习会让这项任务更容易。|She needs more practice with spoken English.|她需要更多英语口语练习。
remember|v.|记得；记住|remember a name|I can remember her face but not her name.|我记得她的脸，却不记得她的名字。|Please remember to bring your keys.|请记得带钥匙。
forget|v.|忘记|forget to do something|Do not forget to turn off the light.|别忘了关灯。|I often forget where I put my glasses.|我经常忘记把眼镜放在哪里了。
mistake|n.|错误|make a mistake|It is normal to make a mistake when learning.|学习时犯错是正常的。|There is a spelling mistake in the title.|标题里有一处拼写错误。
correct|v.|改正；纠正|correct a mistake|Please correct the mistake in the form.|请改正表格中的错误。|The teacher helped me correct my pronunciation.|老师帮我纠正了发音。
careful|adj.|仔细的；小心的|be careful with|Be careful with these glass cups.|小心拿这些玻璃杯。|A careful check revealed two missing pages.|仔细检查后发现少了两页。
patient|adj.|有耐心的|be patient with|Please be patient with new learners.|请对初学者有耐心。|Our coach is patient even when we repeat a mistake.|即使我们重复犯错，教练也很有耐心。
attention|n.|注意；注意力|pay attention to|Pay attention to the signs near the road.|注意路边的标志。|The unusual sound caught my attention.|那个不寻常的声音引起了我的注意。
concentration|n.|专注；注意力|improve concentration|A quiet room can help improve concentration.|安静的房间有助于提高专注力。|The task requires ten minutes of concentration.|这项任务需要专心做十分钟。
development|n.|发展；成长|personal development|Reading is part of my personal development.|阅读是我个人成长的一部分。|The course supports the development of practical skills.|这门课程有助于发展实用技能。
create|v.|创造；创作|create a story|The children will create a story together.|孩子们将一起创作一个故事。|We can create more space by moving the table.|挪动桌子可以腾出更多空间。
discover|v.|发现|discover a problem|We may discover a better way to solve it.|我们可能会发现更好的解决办法。|You can discover new places by walking around.|到处走走可以发现新的地方。
solve|v.|解决|solve a problem|We worked together to solve the problem.|我们一起解决了这个问题。|Can you solve this puzzle without help?|你能独立解开这道谜题吗？
succeed|v.|成功|succeed in doing|She hopes to succeed in starting her own business.|她希望能成功创办自己的企业。|You are more likely to succeed with a clear plan.|有明确的计划，你更可能成功。
success|n.|成功|achieve success|Hard work alone does not guarantee success.|仅靠努力并不能保证成功。|The school play was a great success.|学校的演出非常成功。
failure|n.|失败|learn from failure|We can learn from failure.|我们可以从失败中学习。|One failure does not mean the plan is useless.|一次失败不代表计划没有用。
encourage|v.|鼓励|encourage someone to try|My friends encourage me to try new things.|朋友们鼓励我尝试新事物。|Teachers should encourage questions in class.|教师应该鼓励学生在课堂上提问。
advice|n.|建议|ask for advice|I asked my teacher for advice.|我向老师征求了建议。|Her advice helped me choose a course.|她的建议帮助我选择了课程。
suggest|v.|建议|suggest a solution|Can you suggest a place for lunch?|你能推荐一个吃午饭的地方吗？|I suggest taking a short break.|我建议休息一会儿。
decision|n.|决定|make a decision|We need to make a decision today.|我们今天需要做决定。|She explained the reasons for her decision.|她解释了做出这个决定的原因。
choose|v.|选择|choose between|You can choose between tea and coffee.|你可以在茶和咖啡之间选择。|Please choose a topic that interests you.|请选择一个你感兴趣的话题。
consider|v.|考虑|consider doing|We should consider taking the train.|我们应该考虑乘火车。|Please consider the cost before you agree.|答应之前请考虑费用。
compare|v.|比较|compare two options|Compare the two options before choosing.|选择之前比较一下两个选项。|We can compare our notes after class.|我们可以课后对照笔记。
prefer|v.|更喜欢|prefer tea to coffee|I prefer tea to coffee.|比起咖啡，我更喜欢茶。|Would you prefer to sit near the window?|你更想坐在窗边吗？
expectation|n.|期望；预期|a realistic expectation|Her expectation of a quick reply was unrealistic.|她期待很快收到回复，但这并不现实。|Her expectation was that the task would take an hour.|她预计这项任务需要一个小时。
realize|v.|意识到|realize the importance of|I did not realize how late it was.|我没有意识到已经这么晚了。|They began to realize the importance of teamwork.|他们开始意识到团队合作的重要性。
apartment|n.|公寓|rent an apartment|They rent a small apartment near the station.|他们在车站附近租了一间小公寓。|The apartment has two large windows.|这间公寓有两扇大窗户。
neighbour|n.|邻居|a friendly neighbour|Our neighbour grows flowers on her balcony.|我们的邻居在阳台上种花。|I asked a neighbour to look after my cat.|我请一位邻居照看我的猫。
kitchen|n.|厨房|in the kitchen|Dad is making soup in the kitchen.|爸爸正在厨房煮汤。|The kitchen needs a new light.|厨房需要一盏新灯。
bathroom|n.|浴室；卫生间|a shared bathroom|The room has a private bathroom.|这间房有独立卫生间。|Please leave the bathroom floor dry.|请保持浴室地面干燥。
room|n.|房间|a spare room|We have a spare room for guests.|我们有一间空房供客人住。|Her room faces a quiet garden.|她的房间朝向一个安静的花园。
furniture|n.|家具|a piece of furniture|This shop sells wooden furniture.|这家商店出售木制家具。|We moved the furniture to clean the floor.|我们挪开家具清扫地板。
cupboard|n.|橱柜；储物柜|a kitchen cupboard|The plates are in the cupboard.|盘子在橱柜里。|She keeps old letters in a small cupboard.|她把旧信放在一个小柜子里。
shelf|n.|架子；搁板|the top shelf|Put the bowl on the top shelf.|把碗放在最上层的搁板上。|The shelf is too high for the child.|这个架子对孩子来说太高了。
blanket|n.|毯子|a warm blanket|I need another blanket tonight.|我今晚还需要一条毯子。|She spread a blanket on the grass.|她在草地上铺了一条毯子。
pillow|n.|枕头|a soft pillow|He prefers a soft pillow.|他更喜欢柔软的枕头。|There is a clean pillow on the bed.|床上有一个干净的枕头。
curtain|n.|窗帘|close the curtain|Please close the curtain before changing clothes.|换衣服前请拉上窗帘。|A thin curtain lets some light into the room.|薄窗帘让一些光透进房间。
comfortable|adj.|舒适的|a comfortable chair|This chair is comfortable for reading.|这把椅子坐着看书很舒服。|Wear comfortable shoes for the walk.|散步时穿舒适的鞋。
quiet|adj.|安静的|a quiet place|We found a quiet place to study.|我们找到了一个安静的学习场所。|The street is usually quiet at night.|这条街夜里通常很安静。
tidy|adj.|整洁的|keep something tidy|Please keep your desk tidy.|请保持书桌整洁。|The room was small but tidy.|这间房小而整洁。
clean|v.|打扫；清洁|clean the floor|We clean the kitchen every evening.|我们每天晚上打扫厨房。|Please clean your shoes before coming in.|进来前请把鞋擦干净。
repair|v.|修理|repair a bicycle|Can you repair this old bicycle?|你能修好这辆旧自行车吗？|They plan to repair the roof next week.|他们计划下周修屋顶。
share|v.|分享；共用|share a room|I share a room with my brother.|我和弟弟共用一个房间。|Would you like to share a pizza?|你想一起分着吃一张披萨吗？
invite|v.|邀请|invite someone to dinner|We want to invite our neighbours to dinner.|我们想邀请邻居来吃晚饭。|They will invite a writer to speak at school.|他们将邀请一位作家到学校演讲。
guest|n.|客人|welcome a guest|Each guest received a small gift.|每位客人都收到了一份小礼物。|Our first guest arrived before six.|我们的第一位客人六点前就到了。
meal|n.|一餐；饭|prepare a meal|We prepared a meal for the visitors.|我们为来访者准备了一顿饭。|The price includes one hot meal.|价格包含一顿热饭。
vegetable|n.|蔬菜|vegetable soup|I made vegetable soup for lunch.|我做了蔬菜汤当午餐。|Each child chose a different vegetable to grow.|每个孩子选了一种不同的蔬菜来种。
fruit|n.|水果|fresh fruit|We bought some fresh fruit at the market.|我们在市场买了一些新鲜水果。|There is a bowl of fruit on the table.|桌上有一碗水果。
fresh|adj.|新鲜的|fresh bread|The shop sells fresh bread every morning.|这家店每天早晨出售新鲜面包。|These flowers still look fresh.|这些花看起来还很新鲜。
delicious|adj.|美味的|a delicious meal|The soup smells delicious.|这汤闻起来很香。|Thank you for the delicious meal.|谢谢你做的美味饭菜。
hungry|adj.|饥饿的|feel hungry|I feel hungry after the long walk.|走了很久以后我觉得饿了。|The hungry children waited for lunch.|饥饿的孩子们等着吃午饭。
thirsty|adj.|口渴的|feel thirsty|The warm weather made us thirsty.|温暖的天气让我们口渴。|If you are thirsty, there is water in the kitchen.|如果你口渴，厨房里有水。
cook|v.|做饭；烹饪|cook dinner|I will cook dinner tonight.|我今晚来做饭。|He learned to cook while living alone.|他独居时学会了做饭。
wash|v.|洗；清洗|wash your hands|Please wash your hands before eating.|吃饭前请洗手。|We need to wash these cups.|我们需要清洗这些杯子。
lunch|n.|午餐|have lunch|We usually have lunch at twelve.|我们通常十二点吃午饭。|She packed her lunch before leaving home.|她出门前装好了午饭。
dinner|n.|晚餐；正餐|after dinner|We went for a walk after dinner.|晚饭后我们去散步了。|Would you like to stay for dinner?|你愿意留下来吃晚饭吗？
customer|n.|顾客|a regular customer|She is a regular customer at this shop.|她是这家店的常客。|The customer asked for a smaller size.|顾客要求换一个小一点的尺码。
shop|n.|商店|a local shop|There is a flower shop near my home.|我家附近有一家花店。|The shop opens at nine on weekdays.|这家店工作日九点开门。
supermarket|n.|超市|at the supermarket|I bought milk at the supermarket.|我在超市买了牛奶。|The new supermarket is next to the station.|新超市就在车站旁边。
price|n.|价格|a reasonable price|The price includes delivery.|这个价格包括运费。|We found a good coat at a reasonable price.|我们以合理的价格找到了一件好外套。
cost|n.|费用；成本|the total cost|The total cost was higher than expected.|总费用比预期高。|We shared the cost of the taxi.|我们分摊了出租车费。
cheap|adj.|便宜的|a cheap ticket|We found a cheap place to eat.|我们找到了一处吃饭便宜的地方。|The bag was cheap but lasted for years.|这个包很便宜，却用了好几年。
expensive|adj.|昂贵的|an expensive gift|This jacket is too expensive for me.|这件夹克对我来说太贵了。|Eating out every day can be expensive.|每天在外面吃饭可能很花钱。
quality|n.|质量|good quality|The shoes are of good quality.|这双鞋质量很好。|We check the quality of every product.|我们检查每件产品的质量。
quantity|n.|数量|a small quantity|We only need a small quantity of paint.|我们只需要少量油漆。|Write the quantity beside each item.|在每项物品旁写上数量。
cash|n.|现金|pay in cash|Can I pay in cash?|我可以付现金吗？|He carried a little cash for the bus.|他带了一点现金坐公交车。
payment|n.|付款|make a payment|You can make a payment online.|你可以在线付款。|We will send the goods after receiving payment.|收到付款后我们会发货。
receipt|n.|收据|keep the receipt|Keep the receipt in case you need to return the item.|保留收据，以备退货时使用。|The receipt shows the date of purchase.|收据上显示了购买日期。
change|n.|找零|the correct change|The assistant gave me the correct change.|店员找给了我正确的零钱。|I put the change in my pocket.|我把找回的零钱放进了口袋。
afford|v.|买得起；负担得起|afford to buy|I cannot afford to buy a new car.|我买不起新车。|Can we afford a larger apartment?|我们负担得起更大的公寓吗？
spend|v.|花费（金钱或时间）|spend money on|I try to spend less money on snacks.|我尽量少花钱买零食。|How much time do you spend reading each day?|你每天花多少时间阅读？
save|v.|节省；储蓄|save money|Cooking at home can save money.|在家做饭可以省钱。|She wants to save enough for a bicycle.|她想存够钱买一辆自行车。
bargain|n.|便宜货；划算的交易|a real bargain|This coat was a real bargain.|这件外套买得真划算。|I found a bargain at the second-hand shop.|我在二手店淘到了一件便宜好货。
sale|n.|特价销售|on sale|These shoes are on sale this week.|这些鞋本周特价销售。|The winter sale begins on Monday.|冬季特卖周一开始。
product|n.|产品|a new product|The company introduced a new product.|这家公司推出了一款新产品。|Read the instructions before using the product.|使用产品前请阅读说明。
label|n.|标签|read the label|Read the label before washing the shirt.|洗这件衬衫前先看标签。|The label shows where the bag was made.|标签上标明了包的产地。
size|n.|尺寸；尺码|the right size|This shirt is the right size for me.|这件衬衫的尺码适合我。|Do you have this coat in a larger size?|这件外套有大一号的吗？
fit|v.|合身；尺寸合适|fit well|These shoes fit me well.|这双鞋很合脚。|The table will not fit through the door.|这张桌子过不了这扇门。
order|v.|订购；点餐|order online|You can order the book online.|你可以在线订购这本书。|We decided to order two bowls of noodles.|我们决定点两碗面。
deliver|v.|送达；递送|deliver a package|They will deliver the package tomorrow.|他们明天会送达包裹。|Does this restaurant deliver food to our street?|这家餐厅给我们这条街送餐吗？
package|n.|包裹|open a package|A package arrived for you this morning.|今天早晨有一个你的包裹送到了。|Please check the package before signing.|签收前请检查包裹。
select|v.|挑选|select an item|Please select an item from the list.|请从清单中选一项。|We will select the best design tomorrow.|我们明天会选出最佳设计。
variety|n.|多种多样；种类|a variety of|The market sells a variety of fruit.|这个市场出售各种水果。|We offer a wide variety of sizes.|我们提供多种尺码。
purchase|v.|购买|purchase a ticket|You can purchase a ticket at the entrance.|你可以在入口处购票。|They plan to purchase a new printer.|他们计划购买一台新打印机。
worth|adj.|值得的；值……钱的|be worth doing|This book is worth reading.|这本书值得一读。|The repair is worth the money.|这次维修值得花这笔钱。
guarantee|n.|保修承诺；保证|a one-year guarantee|The camera comes with a one-year guarantee.|这台相机附带一年保修。|Keep the guarantee with the receipt.|把保修凭证和收据放在一起。
travel|v.|旅行|travel by train|I prefer to travel by train.|我更喜欢乘火车旅行。|They hope to travel around China next year.|他们希望明年环游中国。
